name: Manchester Grand Hyatt San Diego
positioning: Waterfront Grand Hyatt in downtown San Diego, beside Embarcadero Park and steps from the San Diego Convention Center
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown waterfront base near Petco Park and the Convention Center
Families wanting connecting suites or a studio with a kitchenette
Groups and conference attendees needing large meeting and event space

facts.text: The hotel is a waterfront hotel in downtown San Diego.
The hotel is steps from Petco Park and the San Diego Convention Center.
Embarcadero Park sits at the doorstep of the hotel.
The 1,450-square-foot Penthouse Suite has top-floor views of the bay or the surrounding city.
The bay-view rooms have decor that blends coastal luxury with nautical charm.
The Signature Suite with two double beds connects to a standard double bed room, making it a family suite.
The 700-square-foot King Bed Studio has a kitchenette with a microwave and a minifridge.
Coastline Pool & Lounge is on the 3rd floor of Harbor Tower, overlooking San Diego Bay.
The StayFit fitness center has waterfront bay views through floor-to-ceiling windows.
Sally's Waterfront Dining is an open-air restaurant with a waterfront terrace and bay views.
The hotel offers 320,000 square feet of meeting and event space with more than 60 breakout rooms.
The hotel was named in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards in 2018 and 2025.

highlights.text: Coastline Pool & Lounge has plush loungers, private cabanas and views of the Coronado Bridge.
Top of the Hyatt, on the 40th floor, offers panoramic views of San Diego Bay and signature drinks.
The 1,050-square-foot Presidential Suites offer sunset views of the bay, a separate living space and upscale decor.
Registered guests can play complimentary basketball and pickleball on the rooftop Sports Court on the 4th floor of Harbor Tower.
The Grand Club lounge is on the 33rd floor and offers breakfast, appetizers and beverages.

considerations.text: A daily destination fee is applied to each room.
The hotel does not accept cash as payment; all major credit cards are accepted.
WhataHotel notes the very large property may require longer walks to amenities.
